name: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper Breakfast: Plain Bagel, Oatmeal, Banana & Yogurt
brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Salt Lake City Draper (Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Every TownePlace Suites breakfast bar stocks toasted plain white bagels, hot plain oatmeal, ripe bananas, Rice Chex/Corn Flakes, and individual Chobani Greek yogurts—plus every room has a full kitchen!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast a plain white bagel or English muffin with peanut butter or cream cheese, grab a ripe banana, or top plain hot oatmeal with brown sugar and banana slices (skipping the walnuts and dried cranberries).
watchOuts: Skip the walnut, almond, and dried raisin/cranberry toppings at the oatmeal bar
Skip the orange and grapefruit juice dispensers
